Learning about this topic is worthwhile because customers can understand what can be done about a problem.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giao tiếp lịch sự cần đi cùng quy trình và quyền xử lý để khách nhận được bước tiếp cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: So sánh hai phương án còn lại
paragraphs.text: I would not choose the guide this time. It could be useful for later revision, but it would not give us immediate feedback when we have questions. Short videos would be convenient too, but watching them separately would not meet our wish to practise together with someone who can help.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không nói hai cách kia vô ích; chỉ ra vì sao ít phù hợp trong tình huống này.

paragraphs.label: Giới hạn và kết luận
paragraphs.text: Of course, I would still check that the information is suitable for a beginner. One point I would want to understand is that staff may be unable to solve problems without authority. After learning the basics, I could try one small idea and see whether it helps. For these reasons, my first choice would be the most practical starting point.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận giới hạn, quay về lựa chọn đã nêu.

options: Attend a customer communication workshop
Read a beginner's guide to customer service training
Watch short videos about customer service training
